instruction.text: Match the correct heading with each statement.

atoms.b:
((US_states))
The United States of America consist of fifty states, two of which are not connected to the mainland, namely Hawaii and Alaska.

((Geographical_location))
The rest are located on the North American continent, with Canada bordering in the North and Mexico in the South.

((The_capital_city))
The nation's capital is Washington, D.C., which is not part of any state but is its own federal district.

((Regional_divisions))
The USA is divided into four general regions: The Northeast, the South, the Midwest and the West.

The Northeast is the smallest region, encompassing the fewest states. Some of the earliest European colonies were founded here, such as Plymouth Colony, ((Boston)) and Connecticut Colony.
The settlers came from various Western European countries and as a result, while individual states do have strong local identities, there is no single cultural ((identity)) shared across the entire Northeast.
The Atlantic Ocean generates a temperate climate in the region. While the ((coast)) is mostly flat, the ((Appalachian)) Mountains further inland create a rocky terrain.

hint.label: Vocabulary

atoms.b: People in the Northeast are generally the ((least)) religious and most liberal in the USA. Overall, the Northeastern states have consistently favoured the ((Democratic)) Party in the past decades.

Although small, the Northeast is the most densely populated region. New York City, the city with the highest ((population)) in the entire US, is located here. Various companies are based in Northeastern cities, ranging from insurance and ((finance)) to healthcare or electrical appliances. Less urban areas focus more on agriculture, the mining of minerals and tourism.

instruction.text: Decide whether the statement is true or false.

atoms.a: Some of the first European colonies on the American continent were located in the Northeast.
For its small size, there are many people living in the Northeast.
The Northeast has a low number of states in comparison to other regions.
The Northeast has a diverse economy.
The Northeast is the most religious region in the USA.

wrong.text: It is the least religious region in the USA.

atoms.a: The Northeastern landscape is entirely flat.

wrong.text: While some coastal regions are flat, the inland is marked by the Appalachian Mountains.

atoms.a: People in the Northeast are the least Democratic.

wrong.text: People in the Northeast tend to be the most liberal and Democratic.

atoms.a: People in the Northeast share a strong, unified cultural identity.

wrong.text: While individual states have their own cultural identities, there is none shared across all Northeastern states.

hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>humid</lang> bedeutet feucht. <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>swamp</lang> bedeutet Sumpf
hint.label: Vocabulary

atoms.b: The South has a rather warm and humid climate, reaching ((subtropical)) temperatures in the far South. From the Atlantic coast with Florida's swamps and bayous, to the ((forests)) in the Appalachians, and the hot steppe areas of Texas, it spans a wide and diverse ((landscape)). Washington D.C., the nation's ((capital)), is located in the South.

Historically, slave labour was a big part of the South's economy. With agriculture as an important factor for ((economic)) growth, the enslaved mostly worked on plantations. The Southern states formed the Confederate States during the American Civil War, fighting to keep their right to own ((slaves))—without success. Today, the people of the South are typically ((conservative)) and Republican-leaning.

Still, the area is quite racially diverse. About half of all ((Black)) Americans live in the Southern region. The South is also by far the most religious area in the United States. It has the largest population of Protestant Christians, especially ((Evangelicals)), a conservative branch of Christianity. The Bible Belt spans practically the entire South.

instruction.text: Decide whether the statement is true or false.

atoms.a: Agriculture is an important economical factor for the South.
People in the South value tradition and conservatism.
The South has a large population of African Americans.
Most American Evangelical Christians live in the South.
The Southern states fought for slavery to be abolished in the Civil War.

wrong.text: They fought for slavery to continue being legal.

atoms.a: The South has a rather cold climate.

wrong.text: The climate in the South is warm and humid.

atoms.a: The South is politically left-leaning and liberal.

wrong.text: Most people in the South favour the right-leaning Republican Party.
